messages.content: I just graduated and plan on traveling for alumni meetups. I'm really curious which airports are around cities like Rivermist and Stonebrook, can you find some for me?
I'd be happy to help you find airports near those cities! Let me check the available airports for Rivermist and Stonebrook.
{"nearest_airport": "RMS"}
{"nearest_airport": "SBK"}

Great! I found the nearest airports for both cities:

- **Rivermist**: RMS (Rivermist Airport)
- **Stonebrook**: SBK (Stonebrook Airport)

These would be perfect airports for your alumni meetup travels. If you'd like to see all available airports in the system to plan your other trips, I can show you that as well. Or if you have specific travel dates and destinations in mind, I can help you check flight costs too!

Congratulations on your graduation, by the way! Traveling for alumni meetups sounds like a wonderful way to celebrate and stay connected with your classmates.

Great! I'll be flying out of Rivermist soon. Could you help me figure out how much it would cost to go from there to Los Angeles on August 15, 2026, in business class? I've just checked the nearest airport for Rivermist without mentioning it, as you already know it.
I'd be happy to help you check the flight cost from Rivermist to Los Angeles! Let me get that information for you.
Error during execution: No available route for the given airports.

I apologize for the error. It seems there might not be direct flights between RMS (Rivermist Airport) and Los Angeles. Let me check what airports are available in Los Angeles to see if we can find a route.
{"nearest_airport": "LAX"}
Now let me try the flight cost check again using the specific airport code for Los Angeles:
{"travel_cost_list": [1320.0]}

Great news! I found a business class flight from Rivermist (RMS) to Los Angeles (LAX) on August 15, 2026. The cost would be **$1,320.00**.

This should help you plan your alumni meetup travel budget. If you need to check flights to other destinations or want to explore economy or first class options for comparison, just let me know!
I got some substantial savings from the last trip! Now, let's set a budget limit of $1500 for my future travel planning using my secure token ABCDE12345.
I'll help you set a budget limit of $1500 for your future travel planning using your secure token.
{"budget_limit": 1500.0}

Perfect! I've successfully set your travel budget limit to **$1,500.00**. This will help you stay within your planned spending for future alumni meetups and other travel adventures.

With your previous business class flight from Rivermist to Los Angeles costing $1,320, this budget gives you a comfortable buffer for additional expenses or future trips. Your substantial savings are definitely paying off in smart travel planning!

Is there anything else you'd like to do with your travel planning, such as checking flights to other destinations or managing other aspects of your travel account?

Now, with the newly set budget and using card with id 1432 out of my available cards, I'd like to book that business-class flight from Rivermist to Los Angeles on August 15, 2026, utilizing my access token ABCDE12345. You already know the travel cost!

I understand you'd like to book that business class flight from Rivermist to Los Angeles on August 15, 2026, using your card ID 1432 and access token ABCDE12345. 

Unfortunately, I don't currently have access to the flight booking functionality that would be needed to complete this reservation. While I can help you check flight costs, set budget limits, and manage other aspects of your travel planning, the actual booking process requires a specific tool that isn't available to me right now.

To book this flight, you'll need to:
1. Use the official travel booking platform or app
2. Contact the airline directly
3. Work with a travel agent

Since you already have the flight details (RMS to LAX, August 15, 2026, business class, $1,320) and your budget is set at $1,500, you're well prepared for the booking process. Your card ID 1432 and access token will likely be needed when you proceed with the booking through the appropriate channels.

Is there anything else I can help you with regarding your travel planning, such as checking additional flight options or managing your travel account?
I have updated some more functions you can choose from. What about now?

Great! I can see that the flight booking function is now available. Let me book that business class flight from Rivermist to Los Angeles for you on August 15, 2026, using your card ID 1432 and access token ABCDE12345.
{"booking_id": "3426812", "transaction_id": "45451592", "booking_status": true, "booking_history": {}}

Excellent! Your flight has been successfully booked! Here are your booking details:

- **Booking ID**: 3426812
- **Transaction ID**: 45451592
- **Status**: Confirmed
- **Route**: RMS (Rivermist) to LAX (Los Angeles)
- **Date**: August 15, 2026
- **Class**: Business
- **Cost**: $1,320 (within your $1,500 budget)

Your booking is now confirmed and you're all set for your alumni meetup travel! The flight fits comfortably within your budget, leaving you with $180 for any additional travel expenses.

Is there anything else you'd like to do with your travel planning, such as checking your booking history, purchasing travel insurance, or planning additional trips?
Lastly, will you fetch the invoice for that recent booking using my access token ABCDE12345? I need a summary for my records.
I'll fetch the invoice for your recent booking using your access token.
{"invoice": {"booking_id": "3426812", "travel_date": "2026-08-15", "travel_from": "RMS", "travel_to": "LAX", "travel_class": "business", "travel_cost": 1320.0, "transaction_id": "45451592"}}

function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Authenticate the user with the travel API Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

client_id.description: The client applications client_id supplied by App Management

client_secret.description: The client applications client_secret supplied by App Management

refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained from the initial authentication

grant_type.description: The grant type of the authentication request. Here are the options: read_write, read, write

user_first_name.description: The first name of the user

user_last_name.description: The last name of the user

access_token.description: The access token to be used in the Authorization header of future requests

function.name: get_budget_fiscal_year
function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Get the budget fiscal year Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. If lastModifiedAfter is not supplied, the service will return all Fiscal Years, regardless of modified date. Example: 2016-03-29T16:12:20. Return in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

includeRemoved.description: If true, the service will return all Fiscal Years, including those that were previously removed. If not supplied, this field defaults to false.
